definition.simple: An atom or a group of atoms that has an electrical charge (like a tiny battery). It can be positive or negative.
definition.academic: An ion is a charged species (an atom or group of atoms) formed by the loss or gain of electrons.

common_misconceptions: Ions are the same as neutral atoms.
Both positive and negative charges move in an atom to form ions.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Remind the student that only electrons are lost or gained to form an ion, not protons.
